definitions.auroc_ap: empirical ROC trapezoids; non-interpolated average precision; tied scores processed together
definitions.bootstrap: sorted union of source/record_id ECGs; unstratified draws with replacement; all panels share cluster multiplicity; absent-panel replicates invalid; fixed-class zero F1 policy; linear percentile CI
definitions.bootstrap_streams: each profile and target view restarts PCG64(seed); no paired cross-profile comparison
definitions.ece_bins: equal width on [0,1]; left inclusive, right exclusive except last includes 1
definitions.ecg_identity: (source, record_id); not a patient or independently verified waveform identity
definitions.macro_f1: unweighted mean binary F1 over the fixed declared classes; F1 zero denominator is 0
definitions.mean_panel_accuracy: unweighted arithmetic mean of panel accuracies; not pooled accuracy or top-1 accuracy
definitions.null_policy: no target/decision/identity rows dropped; missing scores excluded only from probability metrics with denominators disclosed; undefined metrics JSON null with reasons
definitions.pooled_accuracy: sum(tp+tn)/sum(panel rows); P4 ECGs may contribute multiple panel observations
definitions.probability_columns: P6 prob_<class> vs truth_<class>; P8 membership_prob_<class> vs accepted_labels and separately prob_<class> vs target_label; P4 probability vs target
definitions.probability_metrics: classwise one-versus-rest, available scores only; Brier=mean((p-y)^2); ECE=sum(bin_n/score_n * abs(mean(p)-mean(y)))
definitions.supports: rows are observations; positive_support is tp+fn; negative_support is tn+fp; multilabel supports may sum above record count

integrity.git_revision_note: base revision only; implementation hashes include uncommitted generator code
integrity.hash_policy: sha256 is exact bytes; sha256_lf_normalized normalizes CRLF/CR to LF

limitations: Saved predictions only: no waveform inference, retraining, threshold selection or test tuning.
Repeated external-dev evaluation, not untouched external-final or clinical validation; CIs do not correct selection or domain bias.
No validated patient identifiers used; ECG bootstrap is not patient-level uncertainty and cannot exclude dependence between ECGs from one person.
Primary4 panels are selected high-confidence binary cohorts, not a prevalence-representative all-ECG multiclass cohort.
Primary6 and Primary4 have different declared backbones; these results do not validate a single joint checkpoint.
Probability metrics describe named saved score columns only; P8 columns do not consistently reconstruct saved decisions. No decisions are replaced with argmax or retuned thresholds.
Input and code hashes verify bytes, not source-data rights, clinical labels, waveform identity or actual model execution provenance.
Manuscript tables are not inputs: class F1 and panel supports are recomputed, not a verification or edit of manuscript Table 9.

single_target.rule: target_label == predicted_label on all rows; not a strict-single-reference subset
